'''''The Bug Stomper''''' was the name of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunship used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Bug_Stomper_noseart.png|thumb|left|220px|''The Bug Stomper'' nose art]]
The nose of this [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was customized with a painting of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] armored foot squashing a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]], and the vessel's name written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==History==
''The Bug Stomper'' was used in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] of the Clone Wars. It was the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and his troops to go to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]] in search of [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
Like many other references to the 1986 movie [[Wikipedia:Aliens (film)|''Aliens'']] present in the "[[Legacy of Terror]]" episode, ''[[W:c:AVP:Bug Stomper|Bug Stomper]]'' was also the name of the Colonial Marines' dropship in that film.
